parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the asset resides. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: China
- ap-southeast-1: outside China.
